title: La deuda crece
goal: Read how the 1970s oil shocks flooded international banks with petrodollars, which they lent heavily to Latin American governments at variable rates -- leaving the region dangerously exposed by 1982.

items: Explain how the 1970s oil shocks fueled the debt buildup.
Describe who Latin American governments borrowed from and why.
State how much the region's external debt grew, 1975-1982.
Explain what variable interest rates meant for these loans.
Use en consecuencia to express a direct result.
I can explain how the 1970s oil shocks fueled the debt buildup.
I can describe who Latin American governments borrowed from and why.
I can state how much the region's external debt grew, 1975-1982.
I can explain what variable interest rates meant for these loans.
I can use en consecuencia to express a direct result.
